intent: Converge the Foshan open-data 3D viewer into a complete, resilient and honestly-described v1.0 product that works without paid photogrammetry by default.
constraints: Default use requires no paid API key.
Real geographic data and visual estimation must remain distinguishable in UI and documentation.
No unlicensed landmark meshes may be bundled.
No Overpass/OSM extrusion fallback may replace Overture as the default high-fidelity building path.
nonGoals: Claiming generated facade details are surveyed real-world facade details.
Redistributing Google Earth photogrammetry or other proprietary mesh data.
Bundling multi-gigabyte national height datasets in the repository.

requirements.statement: The zero-key default path loads Overture buildings, Terrarium terrain and open satellite imagery by viewport.
Building height sources are prioritized and surfaced truthfully, with optional local open-height overlay support.
Near buildings use categorized PBR facades, roof attributes and safe deterministic visual detail without Math.random.
Tile loading has bounded concurrency, retry, stale-view handling and bounded cache eviction.
The viewer provides adaptive quality, landmark flight, building inspection, shareable view state, day lighting and responsive UI.

checks.description: Static, geo, height, roof and policy tests pass.
Pinned public data endpoints are reachable.
CI browser smoke loads the real page to appReady=true and produces a screenshot artifact.
